source: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing.md — every rate below is a stated table cell on that page, not derived from a multiplier. Verified 2026-09-24.
note: API list prices in USD per MILLION tokens, used only to estimate API-equivalent spend for a subscription session. This is NOT a bill and not a claim about what a weekly allowance actually charges. The multipliers the docs also publish are 1.25x input for a 5-minute cache write, 2x input for a 1-hour cache write, and 0.1x input for a cache read -- EXCEPT Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, whose cache reads are 0.025x (2.5%) of input, and Claude Opus 5.5, whose cache reads are 0.05x (5%) of input. Do not re-derive cache_read from input: for claude-fable-5-1 the standard rule gives $1.00 and is wrong by 4x, and for claude-opus-5-5 it gives $0.40 and is wrong by 2x. Note also that claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-1 share input, output and both write rates and differ ONLY in cache_read, so anything keying on input price alone will misprice one of them. A model id not listed here reports its tokens as unpriced rather than $0 -- see spend.sh totals.unpriced_tokens. The pricing page carries no version stamp, so table_date above is when a human last checked it.
